briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies AGI race as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race to deploy next-gen reasoning models while regulatory scrutiny mounts in US and EU. Funding remains robust but infrastructure bottlenecks slow scaling. Multi-agent security emerges as critical deployment hurdle.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced chain-of-thought capabilities; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind pushed Gemini 3 Ultra and Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B. xAI Grok-3 and DeepSeek-V4 also dropped this week.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra ramp with TSMC; Microsoft and Google both broke ground on new 100k GPU clusters. Power constraints delay several hyperscale projects into 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems before 2027?
